task_title: Fix legacy AI hunt-fixation deadlock (eid-churn persistence fix)

plan_review.notes: Bug A convergent (no better alternative found for health-gating unbounded scan). Bug B major_fork: rejected stuckFrames-based new abandon path (weak signal, bypasses safe-room guard) in favor of repairing updateEngageWatchdog itself to persist progress-tracking across target-identity churn, mirroring the existing shouldClearThreatBeforeNpc precedent. Added churn-regression + no-false-positive test cases. Softened Bug A risk-note overclaim per concern 4. POST-IMPLEMENTATION CORRECTION (isolated A/B repro after initial validation conflated both fixes): Bug B (the churn-reset removal) is the code that actually resolves bow-seed91/throwing-knife-seed14/throwing-knife-seed18 (3/6 sweep repro cases), NOT sword-seed14 as originally hypothesized -- sword-14 has a separate, unfixed root cause (updateEngageWatchdog playerInSafeRoom bypass has no timeout of its own) explicitly deferred as follow-up. Bug A (health-gating Hunt/LeaveSafeRoom unbounded scan radius) was implemented, plan-reviewed, and empirically tested via isolated repro against all 6 cases -- it produced zero measurable effect on any of them, so it was reverted and is NOT part of the shipped diff. Final shipped diff = Bug B only (updateEngageWatchdog churn-persistence fix), proven 3/6.
